data.title: Fans block team bus and lock gate: Game between Vitesse and De Graafschap called off | Flashscore.com
data.content:
De Graafschap said that the club were "negatively surprised and shocked by today's events" and would publish a full statement later on the day, while Vitesse CEO Willem van der Linden called it a "massive disappointment."

"A wonderful Gelderland derby between two regional clubs, in a packed stadium, could not go ahead today," Van der Linden's statement read. The director emphasised that it would not change the conditions of the to-be-played match.
